highlights: The AI agent ecosystem is rapidly expanding with new open-source releases focusing on coding, desktop interaction, and specialized tasks like financial research, alongside crucial cost-saving plugins.

Major frontier models continue to advance, with Google releasing Gemini 4 Argon and significant open-source models like Mistral Large 4 becoming available on platforms like Hugging Face, alongside innovative local-running decision models.

Enterprise AI adoption and strategic partnerships are accelerating, as evidenced by OpenAI's expanded integrations with ServiceNow and Oracle, highlighting a growing trend in embedding AI across core business workflows.

agents.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
agents.summary: DeepSeek has open-sourced 'dsh-superagent', an MIT-licensed router-worker coding agent prototype that significantly reduces task completion times by parallelizing GitHub and Feishu requests, enabling builders to create more efficient and responsive automated coding workflows.

agents.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
agents.summary: Vercel Labs released 'agent-desktop', an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that grants AI agents cross-platform computer use (macOS, Windows, Linux) by interacting with OS accessibility trees, providing a robust foundation for developers to build agents that can operate human-like interfaces.

agents.title: Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 at 11x Lower Cost
agents.summary: Samaya AI's Sterling is a specialized 3B-active finance research agent model, built on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, which outperforms Claude Fable 5.1 on financial benchmarks at significantly lower cost, empowering financial services builders to leverage highly efficient and accurate AI for research tasks.

models.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
models.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Argon, their latest frontier model, making it accessible to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers to tackle complex challenges and push the boundaries of AI applications.

models.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex Max v1: A 27B Decision Model That Runs Locally on Apple Silicon
models.summary: Nace AI has open-sourced Drex Max v1, a 27B multimodal decision model designed to run efficiently and locally on Apple Silicon, offering developers a powerful, accessible model for on-device decision-making applications.

models.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
models.summary: Mistral Large 4, a powerful new language model, is now available on Hugging Face, providing developers with enhanced capabilities for advanced natural language processing tasks and broader accessibility for deployment.

tools.title: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
tools.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past agent sessions to reduce coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% without modifying the agent, offering a significant cost-optimization tool for developers.

tools.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass
tools.summary: Prime Intellect has released Prime Mega MoE, introducing a backward pass for DeepSeek’s fused Mega MoE kernel, which makes the kernel trainable and accelerates Qwen3 MoE training steps by up to 34%, drastically improving training efficiency for builders working with Mixture-of-Experts models.

tools.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
tools.summary: IBM's Granite Switch 4.1.1 offers a novel approach to model management, allowing models to be updated and deployed with the same ease and version control as software, streamlining MLOps for developers managing complex AI systems.

companies.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
companies.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow are deepening their partnership to embed OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows and integrate ServiceNow capabilities into ChatGPT and Codex, accelerating enterprise AI adoption and efficiency across critical business processes.

companies.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI and Oracle have expanded their collaboration to integrate business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT, while also powering new Oracle offerings, significantly enhancing how enterprises can leverage AI within their existing software ecosystems.

companies.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
companies.summary: OpenAI is implementing a shared robots.txt signal to enable website operators to communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers, fostering greater control over data usage and promoting more transparent AI development practices.

learning.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google has launched a new 'AI Quest' lesson titled 'Polar Peaks' focusing on neuroscience, providing an engaging opportunity for individuals to enhance their AI literacy by exploring how AI can be used to map the human brain.
